study: Microduck paired reward-scale post-training and RLinf worker failure cleanup
limits: Two post-training seeds share one initial pretrained-by-RL policy; not independent pretraining replicates.
Evaluation seeds are not training replicates; error bars are sample standard deviations, not confidence intervals.
Reward weights differ; training return must not be used as a cross-recipe quality ranking.
Shared GPU and host workload; no throughput comparison.
Primary Microduck command and exploratory speed evaluations use the default environment at curriculum step 144000, no pushes and neutral head/body commands; disturbance evaluations enable pushes.
RLinf CPU worker fault injection is distinct from normal GPU training.
